notes: #246 CUDA depth instrument fill: gemma4-26B-A4B has cuda depth rows only at 256 (g4moe_cuda_decode_ms_per_token_at_depth_256_expert_residency_ab reads 38.5 bare / 24.0 nvfp4-experts), so the family's rival comparison has been read off wgpu columns; this ladder lands the cuda serving shape at the wgpu-comparable rungs, 196608 matching the g4moe-26b wgpu depth-stack rows
rationale: The serving decode for this family is the eager run_sampling_gemma4_moe loop (chat_engine/build.rs: 'Gemma4Moe and Qwen3 build no graph'), so the eager forward_with_cache step over the bf16 sliding-ring Gemma4KvCache IS the serving shape and the bare arm times exactly what a default deployment runs. run_sampling_gemma4_moe arms nothing beyond defaults -- NV_G4MOE_CUDA_NVFP4 and NV_G4MOE_EXPERT_BT_GEMM are opt-in, so there is no default-on decode-fix equivalent and the spec stays single-arm. Coverage fill, not an adjudication: rows land as labeled facts about the unarmed path and no margin is quoted from this spec. The rival re-comparison itself needs the g4 GGUF re-fetch, tracked elsewhere.
